<subject>Component Order Forecasts 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Supplier Quality Manager for the A380 wing spar project this year. I know that you were the component managers for your line(s) last year. I do not have confirmation as to who the component managers are for your lines this year. Will you please respond to this email and let me know if you are a component manager for a line this year? If you are not your line's component manager, would you please (if you know) tell me who is this year's manager (please include the line number(s) in your return email. I have sent out three emails to the line managers today and would like to get the information to your line's manager as soon as possible. Thanks for your help!
</body>
<quoted>

</quoted>
